title: Kissed Tunisian Ricotta Tagine
description: A creamy, pepper‑rich Tunisian tagine with ricotta that stays al‑dente and is perfect for meal prep, featuring anti‑inflammatory spices.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in garlic, ginger, cumin, paprika, turmeric, and cayenne; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add sliced bell pepper and zucchini; sauté until slightly softened, about 5 minutes.
Pour in diced tomatoes and vegetable broth; bring to a gentle simmer and cook 10 minutes to develop flavors.
Reduce heat to low, stir in ricotta and a pinch of salt; let heat through and thicken slightly, about 2 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning with pepper; remove from heat.
Transfer to a heat‑proof dish, garnish with chopped cilantro, and allow to cool before refrigerating for meal prep.
When ready to serve, reheat gently over low heat until warm, stirring occasionally.
